ADR-0058. 25 -> 21, four call sites to methods this checkout defines nowhere.

l10n_my_edi_pos called consolidated_invoice._separate_orders_in_lines; the module
renamed it _split_pos_orders_in_lines and its one caller, in a sibling file of the
same module, was never followed.

hr_holidays_attendance._update_leaves_overtime made two dead calls in eight lines:
hr.attendance._attendance_date(dt, employee), which is now
_get_day_start_and_day(employee, dt) -- arguments the other way round, and
returning a (datetime, date) pair of which the caller wants the second -- and
._update_overtimes(), which is _update_overtime.

account_edi_ubl_cii tests _import_as_attachment_on carried an `if file_path:`
branch calling cls._import_as_attachment, a helper no checkout defines. All seven
callers pass attachment=, none passes file_path, so the parameter went with the
branch.

TRIAGE OF THE REST, recorded so the next reader starts here: of the 21, NINE are
not debt. They are soft calls into enterprise from community addons behind a
proper capability check -- l10n_it_edi guards _predict_product/_predict_account/
_predict_taxes on _is_prediction_enabled(), which searches ir.module.module for an
installed account_accountant. CI checks this repository out alone, so they read as
unresolved and always will; the true reading is 12 and one command away wherever
enterprise sits beside this checkout:

    python tooling/architecture/py_unresolved_calls.py --also-define enterprise --top 0

Do not allowlist the nine: EXTERNAL is a claim that the RECEIVER is external, and
an account.move.line is not.
